summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Aaron Garcia, an American football quarterback. It covers his birth in Sacramento, California, his high school years at Grant Union High School, and his college career, which began at Washington State University and continued at California State University, Sacramento.
one_line: Aaron Garcia is an American football quarterback born in Sacramento who played college ball at Washington State and Sacramento State.
key_facts: Aaron Garcia was born in Sacramento, California.
Aaron Garcia attended high school in Sacramento at Grant Union High School.
Aaron Garcia graduated from high school in 1989.
After graduating from high school in 1989, Aaron Garcia enrolled at Washington State University.
At Washington State University, Aaron Garcia played quarterback for the Cougars.
Aaron Garcia started for two seasons as quarterback for the Washington State Cougars.
Aaron Garcia transferred to California State University, Sacramento in 1992.
At California State University, Sacramento, Aaron Garcia started for two seasons.
